_about: Geography and travel the PNEU programmes set, including Hakluyt (14 of the Goldsmid edition's 16 volumes; 15-16 are not on Gutenberg), Mungo Park, Eothen and Isabella Bird. Added in reading-lists batch 10 (2026-10-30), at Adam's request: books set by Charlotte Mason's PNEU programmes or named in her Home Education series that no shelf on any branch held (docs/reading-lists/charlotte-mason/). No uids minted.
